brief.subject: FTC moves to block $3.5 billion vet supply merger
brief.headline: FTC Sues to Stop Vet Supply Merger It Says Could Raise Pet Care Costs
brief.dek: Regulators challenge Covetrus's $3.5 billion bid for rival MWI, and two store and brokerage credit cards get a closer look.
brief.lede: The FTC has sued to block Covetrus from buying its closest rival, MWI, for $3.5 billion. The agency warns the deal could push up prices for vet clinics and pet owners.

sections.heading: FTC Targets Vet Supply Merger
bullets: $3.5 billion: the price of Covetrus's planned purchase of MWI Veterinary Supply, which the FTC has sued to block.
The FTC says the deal would join the two largest distributors of veterinary products and services.
Regulators allege the merger would lift costs for clinics, which pet owners could see in their vet bills.
Covetrus owners Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and TPG are also named in the suit.

sections.heading: Store and Brokerage Cards Explained
bullets: The Albertsons forU American Express Card works at any store in the Albertsons family.
Each Albertsons-family store also offers its own dedicated card, so shoppers may face several similar choices.
The Ameriprise credit card's perks mainly benefit people who already hold Ameriprise accounts.
For anyone without an Ameriprise account, the card offers little value, a review finds.
